headline: [Report] “We'll hand over 1,000 pyeong of a semiconductor factory to materials, parts and equipment firms”… SK hynix's world-unique bold experiment
summary: SK hynix plans to hand over 1,000 pyeong of a semiconductor factory to materials, parts and equipment firms, using shared infrastructure. The report cites a severe shortage of mass-production lines.
why: SK hynix is a major South Korean memory chip maker, and its fab capacity decisions shape global supply of DRAM and NAND memory.
